module: Terrain material painting on a polygonal ring (scanline fill) or on a list of cells, with an undo record. A record is { xs, ys, prev, cnt }: world coordinates of each painted cell and its ORIGINAL material index, to restore the previous state exactly. Each record is a live overlay until revert or release; records stack in paint order, and liftAll/layAll remove and put them all back (terrain save, repainting the network underneath). A single grid update is done on the touched area.
notes: Terrain holes (index 255) are never repainted or restored over.
liftAll/layAll nest by counter: only the outermost call does the work. Always call them as a pair in the same frame.
liftAll forgets the records painted on a terrain block that no longer exists.
All functions use extensions.editor_terrainEditor; without a terrain block or without the terrain editor, paintRing and paintCells return nil.

paintRing.desc: Paints the terrain cells inside `ring` (scanline fill), then refreshes the grid over the touched box. Returns the undo record, nil if nothing was painted.

ring.desc: Ring of points in world XY (at least 3).

mat.desc: Layer index for the whole ring, or a function mat(gx, gy, wx, wy) queried per cell that returns an index, or nil to leave the cell.

paintCells.desc: Paints an explicit list of cells (world xs/ys) all with `matIdx`.

prev.desc: Original materials already known; if absent or empty, they are read from the terrain.

returns.desc: Undo record, nil if the list is empty or there is no terrain.

revert.desc: Puts the cells of a record back to their original materials then does a single grid update. Records painted over it since are removed first then put back, so each cell gets back what was really underneath.

rec.desc: Record returned by paintRing or paintCells.

release.desc: Hands the paint of a record over to the terrain (engraving, baking): it stays painted and is no longer removed with the rest.

liftAll.desc: Removes the paint of all live records, from newest to oldest. Nests: only the outermost call acts. No grid refresh, layAll always follows in the same frame.

layAll.desc: Puts the paint back, from oldest to newest, over what is now underneath, then refreshes the grid over the touched area.
